show.description: Railway Minister Narendra Jha survives an assassination attempt but urgently needs a heart transplant in Patna. With flights grounded, the only hope is Dr. Nihal Mathur - brilliant, controversial, and just reinstated. He has 190 minutes to transport the donor heart and save the Minister. But the mission spirals when socialite Kamya Tiwari, her hot-headed brother Sunny, and her fiancé Kabir Jha sabotage his path with ego and revenge. Every delay pushes the clock closer to death.
